app.title: Create your agent
app.tagline: A self-hosted AI DevOps agent that runs in your environment, with your keys.
app.privacy: This page never asks for your keys. Your choices stay in your browser.
app.invalidLink: That shared link could not be read, so the configurator started fresh.
steps.label: Steps
start.heading: Name your agent and choose where it runs
start.name: Agent name
start.nameHint: Lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens. Used for the bundle and for Kubernetes resources.
target.composeDesc: One machine, started with docker compose.
target.kubernetesDesc: A cluster, installed with Helm. Builds go through your CI.
model.heading: Choose a model provider
model.name: Model id
model.nameHint: Copy the model id from your provider. You can switch the model, or the provider, later in the console.
connectors.heading: Choose what the agent can work with
connectors.intro: Everything is read-only unless you allow more. Every write needs your approval. Destructive actions are blocked.
connectors.needs: What the setup will ask for
review.heading: Review permissions
review.secrets: Secrets the setup will ask for
review.secretsNote: Names only. You enter the values in your own environment, never on this page.
review.approversHint: Slack user ids like U0123ABCD, or Slack names like @omar that init looks up and replaces with the id, or console approvers like console:omar, separated by commas. console:admin is the console's admin, who signs in with a password. Each other console approver gets their own sign-in token.
review.noProblems: Everything checks out. You can download your agent.
download.heading: Download your agent
download.blocked: Fix the problems listed in Review before downloading.
download.quickstart: Unzip it, then run these commands in that folder:
download.shareHint: The link holds your choices only. It never holds keys.
preview.heading: Preview
error.url: Enter an http or https URL.
error.pattern: This value has the wrong format.
error.integerRange: Enter a whole number from {min} to {max}.
error.nameFormat: Use lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens, starting and ending with a letter or digit, up to 53 characters.
error.approverFormat: {value} is not a Slack handle like @omar, a Slack user id, or a console approver like console:omar.
error.comingSoon: This connector is coming soon and cannot be enabled yet.
review.consoleCompose: An Overview of your systems and what needs attention, a Dashboard, approvals, activity, usage, and Settings for the model, connectors, and secrets. It listens on this machine only, at http://localhost:8081. Sign in as admin with the password admin, then choose a new password.
review.consoleKubernetes: An Overview of your systems and what needs attention, a Dashboard, approvals, activity, usage, and Settings for the model, connectors, and secrets. It is not exposed outside the cluster: you reach it with kubectl port-forward. Sign in as admin with the password admin, then choose a new password.
error.approverConsoleOff: {value} approves in the web console. Turn the console on, or remove {value}.
review.consoleChat: Ask the agent questions in the console. Changes still wait for an approver. Console approvers (console:name) approve there; others approve in Slack.
profile.heading: Who is this agent for?
profile.legend: Choose the defaults that fit your organization
profile.starterDesc: One person or a small team getting started. You can approve your own changes, and one approval is enough.
profile.teamDesc: Several people and more than one environment. In production, someone other than the person who asked must approve.
profile.strictDesc: Regulated, audited, or change-managed organizations. Nobody approves their own change, and production changes need two approvers.
profile.note: A profile only sets defaults. You can change any of them later in the console's Settings or in kodra-agent.yaml.
environments.heading: Group namespaces and repositories into environments
environments.intro: Each environment gets its own approval rules. Changes outside every environment use the default approvers from the Review step.
environments.introStarter: Optional. Add an environment when some namespaces or repositories need stricter approvals than the rest.
environments.name: Name
environments.nameHint: Lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens, like production or staging.
environments.productionHint: Production environments get the stricter rules of your profile.
environments.namespacesHint: Separated by commas. A namespace belongs to one environment.
environments.reposHint: Like owner/repo or group/project, separated by commas.
environments.approversHint: Leave empty to use the default approvers from the Review step.
environments.max: You can add up to 10 environments.
rules.selfAllowed: The person who asked may approve it.
rules.selfRefused: The person who asked cannot approve it.
review.rulesProfile: Profile: {profile}. These are the rules the agent will apply.
review.addEnvironments: Add environments with their own rules
error.environmentName: Use lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens, up to 32 characters.
error.namespaceFormat: {value} is not a Kubernetes namespace. Use lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens.
error.repoFormat: {value} is not a repository like owner/repo or group/project.
policy.needsOther: {who} need someone other than the requester. Add a second approver.
policy.needsDifferent: {who} need {min} different approvers. List at least {min}.
policy.needsOthers: {who} need {min} approvers other than the requester. List at least {list}.
policy.duplicateName: {name} is already the name of another environment.
policy.emptyEnvironment: {name} needs at least one namespace or repository.
policy.namespaceTaken: Namespace {namespace} is already in {owner}. A namespace belongs to one environment.
policy.repoTaken: Repository {repo} is already in {owner}. A repository belongs to one environment.
model.nameHintSuggested: Pick one of the suggestions or type another model id. You can switch the model, or the provider, later in the console.
entries.none: None yet. Add them here, or later in the console.
entries.secretsNote: Passwords and keys are never entered on this page. init asks for each one with hidden input and tests it.
entries.name: Name
entries.nameHint: Lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens, like orders-replica. Tools and the console call it by this name.
error.entryName: Use lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens, starting with a letter, up to 40 characters.
error.entryDuplicate: {value} is already the name of another one.
connectors.entrySecrets: Each {noun} you add names its own secrets here.
